cohort: The study included 12 pregnant women diagnosed with chronic renal disease.
finding: The study found that pregnancy associated with chronic renal disease is burdened by serious fetal and maternal complications, including a 95% cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was 95%, primarily due to severe preeclampsia (58% of cases), fetal bradycardia (33.33% of cases), and placentae abruption (8.66% of cases).
